clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind's Park, Argos Nightwhisper guides Alliance travelers toward Darkshore. His brother Gershala studies the corruption spreading there.

Argos Nightwhisper lives among the night elves gathering in Stormwind's Park. The district's quiet groves recall the kaldorei's ancestral woodlands. Like others of his kin stationed in the human kingdom, Argos connects the new allies across the Great Sea. Reports from across the ocean trouble him. He urges capable Alliance champions to travel to Auberdine in Darkshore, where his brother Gershala needs help against the spreading corruption.
